changes.to: WEILAN's AlphaDog E-Series page (read 2026-11-17) 'Reference Specifications' table for the E400L: speed up to 4 m/s, adjustable walking height 25-50 cm, width 20-32 cm, gradeability up to 20 degrees, payload up to 10 kg, V-SLAM, autonomous navigation and dynamic balancing. The maker publishes no mass, length, runtime, DoF or battery capacity, so those fields stay empty; third-party figures (18 kg, 5 h, USD 27,690) are not used.
